title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-04
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 35 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: Sam Altman posted three times; two are worth noting. He called dot "my favorite OpenAI product so far," saying it gets noticeably better every day as it learns his workflow and style, and that offloading the tasks he dislikes — the ones that usually pile up into "a gravity well of dread" — has made him very happy. Responding to speculation about OpenAI's partnership with Cerebras, he said Cerebras is a close partner with deep engagement on pushing the frontier of speed. A third, personal post reflected on the cont…
featured.insightZh: Sam Altman 这次发了三条，有两条值得关注。第一条，他说 dot 是他"迄今最喜欢的 OpenAI 产品"：它会持续学习他的工作流和风格，每天都能感觉到明显变好，那些他不想做、平时越拖越让人发怵的杂事都交给了它。第二条是针对外界对 OpenAI 和 Cerebras 合作的猜测，他回应说 Cerebras 是紧密合作伙伴，双方在推理速度前沿上有很深的合作。第三条比较个人：白天打完最后一个高风险决策电话，一分钟后进门就面对孩子们单纯的爱和分享欲，他说这种反差是他人生中"最奇怪也最美好"的体验。

featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 主理人
featured.summaryEn: Swyx reminded followers not to miss the "one more thing" — dots, which the team has been working on for a while. He also announced he's back as a founding partner with Snyk for the 2nd AI Security Summit, noting every 2025 partner returned. His take: the landscape has completely transformed in a year — an exploding number of rogue agents, more breaches, more AI-driven attacks — and security "is no longer theoretical" and must be at the center of the AI conversation.
featured.insightZh: Swyx 提醒大家别漏了 OpenAI 发布会上的"one more thing"——dots，并说团队为它准备了很久。另外他宣布作为创始合作方，与 Snyk 一起回归第二届 AI Security Summit：去年所有合作方全部续约。他的判断是一年间格局彻底变了——失控 agent 数量激增、数据泄露更多、AI 驱动的攻击增多，安全问题"已经不再是理论"，必须放到 AI 讨论的中心。

featured.title: Frontier Chips for Frontier AI Labs, with Walter Goodwin (Fractile)
featured.summaryEn: The real bottleneck for inference chips is combining extremely high memory bandwidth with cheap, high-capacity memory. Fractile is betting on SRAM-class bandwidth to DRAM to make long-running agents radically faster, and argues frontier labs will keep needing third-party frontier chip vendors to hedge hardware risk. Walter Goodwin, founder and CEO of full-stack AI chip company Fractile, explained that despite the apparent "zoo" of AI ASICs — Google's TPU, Meta's MTIA, Microsoft's Maia, OpenAI's Jalapeno — most are delivered through a few ASIC houses like Broadcom and share HBM, Tensor Cores and TSMC packaging, making them architecturally similar. Fractile (about 150 people, founded summer 2022) does everything in-house from architecture and front-end design through physical design and advanced packaging to run a faster closed loop. Fractile initially built an SRAM-based chip like Groq o…
featured.insightZh: 推理芯片的真正瓶颈是"既要极高内存带宽、又要便宜的大容量内存"，Fractile 押注让 DRAM 获得 SRAM 级带宽，以服务长时运行 agent 的超高速推理；而前沿实验室出于风险对冲，长期需要第三方前沿芯片厂商。 Fractile 创始人兼 CEO Walter Goodwin 在 No Priors 上讲了这家全栈 AI 推理芯片公司的核心判断。公司 2022 年夏天成立，从一开始就押注"推理时代"和速度。他指出当下 AI ASIC 看似百花齐放（Google TPU、Meta MTIA、Microsoft Maia、OpenAI Jalapeno），但大多由 Broadcom 等少数 ASIC 代工设计公司交付，同样用 HBM、Tensor Core、TSMC 先进封装，架构高度同质化；真正从架构、前端设计一路做到物理设计、工艺和封装的团队很少。Fractile 约 150 人，各环节都自己做，追求的是更敏捷的闭环。 技术路线上，Fractile 前两年做的是和 Groq、Cerebras 类似的 SRAM 方案，带宽极高但容量太小；2023 年底到 2024 年，随着上下文长度增长，他们担心可扩展性，转向与内存厂和晶圆厂合作，为成本更低、容量更大的 DRAM 争取极高带宽，平台计划明年下半年量产爬坡。他认为"更快的聊天机器人"只是"更快的马"，真正的能力跃迁在于把数万亿参数模型以每秒数千 token 运行，让长时运行的 agent 快一个量级；而推理的规模经济最终可归结为每 GB 内存的成本。他还提到过去二十年 FLOPs 增长了约百万倍，内存带宽只涨了约 40 倍；单芯片带宽提升约 25 倍后，更稀疏的 MoE（如 1/128、1/256）和更省带宽的注意力机制才能被高效服务，即所谓"带宽的 scaling law"。 关于节奏和市场：流片周期即便加急也要 3–5 个月，芯片需要 3–5 年摊销，所以缩短设计周期的价值在于"更多射门机会"，如果能结构性地领先 3–6 个月就能赢下部署。对"从架构师意图直接生成 GDS II 要十年"的说法，他的经验法则…

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: Thibault handled a user issue in public: after reports that Pro 500 users didn't get their usage reset as expected, he said the team was investigating and would make up for it, then followed up that it was "all fixed," adding there's a surprising number of Pro 500 users. He also quipped that future models will be "much better at code deletion and simplification. Just in time."
items.insightZh: Thibault 处理了一起用户问题：有用户反馈 Pro 500 档的额度没有按预期重置，他先公开说明正在调查并会补偿，随后宣布"已全部修复"，还顺带感叹 Pro 500 用户比想象中多。另外他调侃说"幸好我们未来的模型会更擅长删代码和做简化，来得正是时候"。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan highlighted a surprise from Capy: his GBrain collaborator Sina kicked off a fix wave that automatically steered around everything Garry was already working on across multiple Capy threads — cross-session coordination, all model-agnostic. He called Capy "a 24/7 standup for your agents." He also restated his goal for GBrain: agents that feel as native and inevitable as the web — not a chatbot feature, but a personal Jiminy Cricket that knows you and is always on, thinking ahead, and improving.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 分享了用 Capy 的意外收获：他在 GBrain 项目上的合作者 Sina 发起了一波修复，系统会自动绕开 Garry 本人在多个 Capy 线程里正在处理的工作——跨 session 协同，而且与模型无关。他形容 Capy"像是给 agent 开的 24/7 站会"。同时他重申 GBrain 的目标：让 agent 像当年的 Web 一样原生、自然、不可避免——不是一个聊天机器人功能，而是一个了解你、24/7 在线、始终提前思考的"贴身蟋蟀"。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Claude's official account showcased two weekend builds: an interactive 3D jet engine you can cut away and pull apart, made with Opus 5.5, and a pop-up city where each building is a paper fold drawn on a flat canvas, made with Sonnet 5.5 — and asked what people are exploring with Claude this weekend.
items.insightZh: Claude 官方晒了两个周末作品：一个可交互的 3D 喷气发动机，可以剖切、拆解，由 Opus 5.5 生成；一个"弹出式城市"，每栋建筑都是平面画布上画出的纸折结构，由 Sonnet 5.5 生成。并发问大家这个周末用 Claude 在探索什么。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from the Claude Code team recommended the "You should know" mod as a great way to stay on top of what's possible with Claude, and a good example of what mods enable: "You can really make Claude Code yours."
items.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 推荐了一个名为 "You should know" 的 mod：它既能帮你及时了解 Claude 能做的新事情，也是 mod 机制能力的一个好例子——"你真的可以把 Claude Code 变成你自己的"。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared a classic "AI replaces SaaS" moment: he was paying nearly $300/year for a YouTube research tool that kept getting more complicated, so he asked Claude to build the core features he actually needed — done in 5 minutes. He also told Alexandr Wang that the Muse desktop app's always-on-screen element when minimized makes him not want to open it, and promoted a free lightning lesson on building an AI system to take work off your plate, working with ChatGPT, Claude, or other harnesses.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 讲了一个典型的"SaaS 被 AI 替代"案例：他每年花近 300 美元订阅一个 YouTube 研究工具，产品越做越复杂，于是他让 Claude 把自己真正需要的核心功能做出来——5 分钟就做好了。另外他吐槽 Muse 桌面应用最小化后仍有个常驻屏幕的浮窗，让他不想再打开它（@了 Alexandr Wang）。他今天还开了一节免费直播课，讲如何搭建 AI 系统分担工作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj shared a fun prompt for home-automation nerds using Claude Code or Codex: have the agent sniff network packets in the house to find what else can be automated. His context: a Hermes agent already runs personal Gmail, thermostat, DoorDash, Amazon and more; there's an Apple TV for HomeKit but no Home Assistant bridge. The prompt asks for a full device list plus research on how each could connect to an agent.
items.insightZh: Nikunj 分享了一个给智能家居玩家的 Claude Code / Codex 提示词：让 agent 嗅探家中网络数据包，找出还能自动化的设备。背景是他家已有一个 Hermes agent 在跑个人 Gmail、温控、DoorDash、亚马逊等，有 Apple TV 可走 HomeKit 但没有 Home Assistant 网关；提示词要求列出所有发现的设备，并调研如何把它们接入 agent。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya announced SPC's second portfolio company IPO this week — Moneyview — praising founders Puneet and Sanjay. He reflected that the founder's journey is long and tough as nails, yet worth it because "to create something new is the highest form of purpose."
items.insightZh: Aditya 宣布 SPC 本周迎来第二家被投公司 IPO——Moneyview，向创始人 Puneet 和 Sanjay 致敬。他说创业之路漫长而艰难，但人们依然去做，因为"创造新事物是最高形式的使命"。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru made a relatable point: the feeling of reading great writing that is 100% human-written is underrated — he loves "that human-written smell in a doc."
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 说了一句很多人会共鸣的话：读到 100% 人类写的好文字，这种感觉被低估了——他就爱文档里那股"人写的味道"。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital VC
items.summaryEn: Matt Turck joked that calling the Bay Area a monoculture is unfair: "it has both neo-clouds AND neo-labs."
items.insightZh: Matt Turck 调侃湾区：大家说它是"单一文化"，这不公平——它既有 neo-clouds（新型云），也有 neo-labs（新型实验室）。

items.title: Claude for Small Business 推出新工作流、集成与培训计划
items.summaryEn: Anthropic expanded Claude for Small Business to 43 workflows and 27 new integrations with tools like Shopify, Salesforce, TikTok, Atlassian, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe and Zapier. Launched in May, it has been installed more than 900,000 times, with original partners including Intuit QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. After over 1,000 owners in 10 cities gave feedback — about a third wanting help growing the business — the release extends Claude from back office to growth: weekly briefs, after-hours lead qualification, voice-memo-to-proposal, marketing prep, and month-end close packets. A fall tour brings free workshops to 10 US cities, with 150+ Approved Claude SMB Trainers running 750+ workshops and 14 integration partners hosting webinars. Customer quotes include "120 hours now takes five minutes" and $20,000 earned in six weeks fr…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude for Small Business 扩展到 43 个工作流，并新增 27 个集成，覆盖 Shopify、Salesforce、TikTok、Atlassian、Zoom、Xero、Gusto、Square、Stripe、Zapier 等小企业常用工具。该产品今年 5 月上线，已被安装超过 90 万次，原有合作伙伴包括 Intuit QuickBooks、PayPal、HubSpot、Canva、Docusign、Google Workspace 和 Microsoft 365。春季巡回中，10 个城市的 1000 多位店主反馈需求，约三分之一希望 Claude 帮助增长业务（获客、回复咨询、写方案），因此新版本从"管后台"延伸到"做增长"：每周经营简报、夜间自动回复和登记线索、把语音备忘录变成带报价的品牌化方案、准备营销内容、月末对账并给会计生成结账包。秋季将在美国 10 个城市开展免费工作坊，150 多家认证培训机构将举办 750 多场活动，14 家集成伙伴提供免费网络研讨会。用户案例里，有人称原本 120 小时的工作缩短到 5 分钟，有人靠 Claude 写方案一个半月多赚 2 万美元。
